properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 865976
Incident Time: 2008-03-25 05:01:00
Nearest City: Louisville, KY
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL, MISC: LUBRICATING
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS
Skytruth Analysis
POSSIBILITY OF DIESEL FUEL AND/OR LUBE OIL SPILLING INTO THE OHIO RIVER BECAUSE OF NO CONTAINMENT BASINS OR CONTAINMENT BASINS WITH HOLES DRILLED IN THEM FOR RAINWATER TO DRAIN OUT ON DECK. LD 683 - NO LUBE OIL CONTAINMENT UNDER TANK IN SPUD ROOM. DB 10 (LD 710) - OIL, FLUIDS, ETC LEAKING FROM MACHINERY HOUSE IN THE CRANE ONTO THE DECK, THEN RUNNING OR BEING WASHED INTO THE RIVER WHEN IT RAINS. properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 807488 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: TRAVEL CENTERS OF AMERICA
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 807488
Incident Time: 2006-08-07 17:00:00
Nearest City: Kingsville, OH
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL, MISC: MOTOR
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: TRAVEL CENTERS OF AMERICA
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER STATES THAT HIS COMPANY IS A TRUCK STOP STATION AND IS DESIGNED TO WORK ON OIL CHANGES. CALLER STATES THAT VARIOUS OILS INCLUDING DIESEL, MOTOR OIL, AND FREON ARE BEING DUMPED IN AND ONTO FACILITY GROUNDS. CALLER STATES THAT FACILITY IS DESIGNED TO HAVE OIL DRAIN ONTO A RESERVOIR WATER OIL SEPARATOR, BUT OCCASSIONALLY THE DRAINS WILL FLOOD AND OIL LEAKS ONTO THE BASE OF FACILITY. CALLER STATES THAT THE OIL SEEPS UP FROM THE GROUND OF FACILITY, MAKING THE CONDITIONS AND AREA UNSAFE FOR EMPLOYEES. CALLER STATES THE WALLS ARE BUCKLING AND CRACKING, THE FLOOR HAS SHIFTED, AND THERE IS NO VENTILATION WITHIN THE BUILDING. CALLER STATES VENTILATION CONSISTS OF AN OPEN DOOR, AND MORE RECENTLY, A BROKEN WINDOW. CALLER STATES THAT A PRIVATE CONTRACTOR HAS INVESTIGATED THE DRAINS BY SNAKING THEM, AND HAD DETERMINED THAT THE WATER SEPARATOR HAS A BREACH, CAUSING OIL TO SEAP OUT OF THE GROUNDS DUE TO THE DRAINS BEING CRUSHED. CALLER STATES THE MANAGER WAS ADVISED TO HAVE DRAINS REPLACED, AND MANAGER HAS "LAUGHED IT OFF." CALLER STATES MANAGER HAS NO INTENTION OF UPKEEPING FACILITY GROUNDS, AND CONDITIONS OF FACILITY HAVE BECOME A JOKE TO ALL FELLOW WORKERS, POSTING PICTURES OF OIL SPILLS ON THEIR SCREENSAVORS. CALLER STATES THAT EMPLOYEES WERE INSTRUCTED TO KEEP QUIET IF AND WHEN ANY AGENCIES WERE NOTIFIED OF THE PROBLEM(S), OTHERWISE THEY WOULD BE FIRED.
